Dashboard Parts in the Design System

9 Oct 2026. The Beneficiary Dashboard's parts moved into the SAMAVESH design system as six components and a screen template. The dashboard is now built from them and looks the same: 20 views were compared pixel by pixel, and the only differences were live NMBA figures that moved between captures.

What Changed

WhatBeforeAfterWhy
Portal and Department cards on the dashboard landing pageDrawn by the dashboard's own codeDrawn by the design system's Dashboard Card, laid out by Dashboard Card ListAny page that lists dashboards can now use the same card
The blue At a Glance bandDashboard's own codeDesign system's Headline BandReusable opening figures for any dashboard
The coloured head of each programme pageDashboard's own codeDesign system's Dashboard HeaderSame head on every dashboard page
State/UT map with ranked list, and map with Highest/Lowest panelDashboard's own codeDesign system's Area Breakdown and Area ExplorerPM-AJAY, NMBA and others can show State-wise figures the same way
Every KPI chart (rings, bars, lines, funnels, maps, tables)Dashboard's own rendererDesign system's KPI ViewAny register of KPI readings draws itself
SC / OBC / SHREYAS chart switchButtons that said 'pressed'Design system's segmented control, buttons style: one tab stop, arrow keys chooseKeyboard users move through options as in every other choice on the estate
The page frame: back link, 'Figures for All India' bar, filters, focusDashboard's own codeDesign system's Dashboard Screen, the 19th screen templateThe next dashboard starts from a template that already handles loading, empty and error
Page load in developmentJumped to the first headingStays at the topA focus move meant for 'view changed' was firing on load
What a citizen sees—Unchanged, pixel for pixelOnly live NMBA figures differ between captures
